rollback_lineage.rule: Do not reintroduce DE history-cap/price-guard valuation logic into the consolidation baseline.

evaluators.contracts: normalized auction/listing records and candidate ordering, including bid-only listings
evaluators.marketbook: persistent normalized per-scan book with item/page indexes and separate buyout/bid-only counts
evaluators.vendor: realm-learned merchant_sell first, Turtle DB fallback
evaluators.disenchant: live/depth material book with AH cut, safety margin and exposure guard; no history price cap
evaluators.flip: read-only AUX history anchor plus live market depth, seller depth, item exposure, AH cut and safety margin
evaluators.stack: small-stack live depth versus large-stack entry with read-only history cap, seller depth, exposure and margin
evaluators.bid: bid-only vendor/DE valuation with duration, amount, profit, safety-margin and session-placement guards
evaluators.pipeline: pure Vendor/DE page evaluation plus DE/Flip/Stack postscan arbitration and Bid fallback

coordination.aux_adapter: observation-only boundary accepting normalized AUX callbacks
coordination.transaction_guard: single future transaction authority; real actions hard-locked in shadow
coordination.autosell: pure cancel-return-reprice-post-reconcile lifecycle emitting intents only
coordination.ledger: persistent bounded economy event ledger with summary aggregation
coordination.parity: pure comparison store for active-vs-shadow decisions and lifecycle states
coordination.parity_bridge: passive hot-reload observer around project-owned AVM_AuxArb callbacks; original callbacks run exactly once and retain their return values
